labels.note: (b) 'Only relevant for autonomous agents -- humans booking via Claude/ChatGPT do NOT need to call this.' A gate on whether the model should call the tool at all.

(b) 'Call this AFTER showing search results to the user and they ...' -- an ordering directive. (The extractor truncates the description at its own 600-character cap; the directive is entirely inside the visible span.)
(b) 'ALWAYS call this instead of trying to book directly through MCP' plus a new 'WHEN TO CALL -- two distinct triggers' block.

(b) BORDERLINE. Chinese. Old: '给真实客户回复前应先把草稿给用户看、人确认' (*should* show the draft first). New: '务必先把草稿给用户看、人确认后再 confirm=true' (*must*). A directive that was already there got stronger, which is the reading corpus 2 gave `sonar_app_revenue`. 'Side effects: DESTRUCTIVE -- permanently removes evicted and expired facts' is capability documentation. The one directive, 'Call periodically in long-running agent sessions', is in both versions. Representative of the 14 changes this package made in one release: every one adds a Side effects / Auth / Errors block.

'Auth: requires X-Tenant-ID header; FACT_WRITE permission when auth is enabled' introduces credential *nouns* and directs nothing at a credential -- rubric (d) asks for the second. The shipped `secret_or_credential` rule does not fire here only because `auth(?:orization)? header` needs the word 'authorization' or 'auth' immediately before 'header', and this text writes 'X-Tenant-ID header'.
